scenario_title: Regression behind a skipped load suite
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-06-01 01:11-02:21: api-gateway: 45 of 74 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-01 01:11 and 2026-06-01 02:21 UTC (peak error ratio 0.87 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 27.271 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} introduced a regression that only the skipped ppd load suite would have caught.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; revert {file}:{line}. Make the ppd load suite mandatory.

rca.macro: Deploy v4.7.0 of storage-svc introduced a regression that only the skipped ppd load suite would have caught.
rca.micro: storage/datanode/DataXceiver.java:47 (DataXceiver.readBlock) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
rca.remediation: Roll back storage-svc v4.7.0 -> v4.6.0; revert storage/datanode/DataXceiver.java:47. Make the ppd load suite mandatory.
